description.p: Diskwise gives a clear picture of every drive in your computer: whether it is healthy, how fast it is, and how much power it uses. It can also format and partition drives, with safeguards that protect the disk your system runs from.

ul.li: Health: SMART and NVMe health logs turned into a score with plain-language findings
Temperature, power-on time, data written and wear
Live throughput, operations per second, utilization and latency
Speed tests: sequential and random read/write, and a read-only surface scan
Estimated power draw, energy use and power management settings
Self-tests, partition layout and device details
Format disks and partitions (ext4, Btrfs, XFS, exFAT, NTFS, FAT32, optional encryption), create and delete partitions, mount, unlock, check and repair
Power off, spin down and persistent drive settings such as standby timeout
